name: Bull Shoals Lake Boat Dock
note: AIR FILLS + dive shop. 140 Boat Dock Cove, Bull Shoals AR 72619. (870) 445-4424. PADI centre: air fills, scuba rental, service and repair. Most dive sites cluster near here, on the Arkansas end by the dam. Position from the street address, two sources agreeing within 30 m - the shop building, not the gas dock.

name: Wagon Wheel / Anchor Pointe Resort
note: AIR FILLS per the 2023-era write-up, BUT the resort is now trading as Anchor Pointe Resort - confirm air is still available before relying on it. 204 Wagon Wheel Ln, Peel AR 72668. (870) 436-5401. Position from two sources agreeing within 60 m; a third source said 36.44077 which is 5.7 km inland and was discarded.

name: Pontiac Cove Marina
note: AIR FILLS per one listing, but the marina's own amenity list does not mention scuba - ring first. 563 Pontiac Cove Rd, Pontiac MO 65729. Closest fill station from the Missouri side. Position good to about 200 m: two sources differ by that much and a third was 1.4 km north.

name: Wreck of the SS Minnow
note: Off the south side of Gilligan's Island. Lined. Training depth.

name: Iowa Farm
note: North side of Gilligan's Island. Sunken tractor and combine.

name: Wreck of the Bull Shoals Express
note: A set of sunken boats. Line starts in about 15 ft and runs down to them.

name: Frost Wall
note: Wall dive on the Frost Point wall. A pirate longboat sits at about 85 ft.

name: Shear Terror
note: Wall dive with overhangs. Depth not stated in the sources.

name: Swim-through wall
note: A wall with a large hole you can swim through. Depth and position not stated.

name: Main channel wall
note: Bottoms out past 200 ft. Old settlements along the original riverbed. Technical.
